_about: Ledger of requests to archives and libraries: a leaf to photograph, a reproduction to order, a book or database the project cannot reach. Seeded from the 'blocker: needs-physical-access' gaps in targets/*/NOTES.md by tools/seed_archive_requests.py (re-run it to add new gaps; hand edits are kept). kind: visit | order | library. status: open -> claimed (a volunteer has it) -> requested (asked the archive) -> received (images or text in hand) -> closed (the gap is closed in NOTES.md); or unavailable (the archive says it is lost or cannot be reproduced). Every change adds a history line {date, status, who, note}. volunteer: {name, contributor (id in contributors.json), month (YYYY-MM, never a day)}. issue: the GitHub issue number. Requests not tied to a target take target null. docs/archives.html is built from this file.
